metadata.logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
metadata.continuity: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

units.text: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.
Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.
Then why did they never find you?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.
Because they made certain no one would look.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.
Who?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.
Sterling... and Rupert.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.
Rupert?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.
They knew where I was.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.
My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.
They gave you to the enemy?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.
They gave them my location.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.
They wanted the investigation buried.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.
And when you disappeared...?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.
They declared me dead.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.
They falsified what remained of the reports.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.
And Rupert took Ashbourne.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.
While the world mourned a dead heir.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.
And I mourned you.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.
I know.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.
I trusted them.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.
You trusted family.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.
They used that trust against you.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.
Mother... Juliana...
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.
She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.
I thought perhaps she stayed with you.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.
Alexander...
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.
What?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.
She did come to me.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.
Is she still at Ashbourne?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.
No...
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.
Then where is she?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.
They arrested her!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.
Arrested?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.
Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.
But she saved you!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.
I told them!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.
You told them the truth!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.
They called her a witch!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.
Juliana... is in a cell?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.
She was taken before a magistrate.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.
And?!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.
They condemned her.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: No.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.
She is to be executed.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.
When?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.
After the wedding.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.
What wedding?
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.
Rupert... and Catherine's.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.
Two days from now.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.
They are marrying in two days...
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.
...and killing my wife afterward.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.
Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.
They already took my name.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.
They stole my home!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.
And now they have taken Juliana!
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.
Two days.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.
Then they have two days to celebrate.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.
Because before that wedding begins...
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.
...their dead Duke is coming home.
units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.
